notebooks.title: Refined Coarse-Grained Dissipation Bounds and Finite Relaxation
notebooks.summary: This revision formalizes how coarse-graining necessitates the use of lower bounds for entropy production retrieval, while trajectory-level inference provides a pathway for evaluating thermodynamic costs in nonequilibrium systems. The integration of variational expressions and coarse-grained data analysis clarifies the gap between ideal Landauer limits and practical information engine operation.
notebooks.findings:
In systems where full Markovian descriptions are inaccessible, coarse-graining prevents the retrieval of exact entropy production, restricting inference to lower bounds. [peer-42ea5272a464585193f493cc]

Trajectory-level entropy production can be inferred for intractable systems using nonequilibrium analogs of the Maximum Entropy principle and convex duality. [source-dc0bb1a28c9b4193]

detail.title: Refined Coarse-Grained Dissipation Bounds and Finite Relaxation
detail.summary: This revision formalizes how coarse-graining necessitates the use of lower bounds for entropy production retrieval, while trajectory-level inference provides a pathway for evaluating thermodynamic costs in nonequilibrium systems. The integration of variational expressions and coarse-grained data analysis clarifies the gap between ideal Landauer limits and practical information engine operation.
detail.findings:
In systems where full Markovian descriptions are inaccessible, coarse-graining prevents the retrieval of exact entropy production, restricting inference to lower bounds. [peer-42ea5272a464585193f493cc]

Trajectory-level entropy production can be inferred for intractable systems using nonequilibrium analogs of the Maximum Entropy principle and convex duality. [source-dc0bb1a28c9b4193]
detail.limitations: Existing models rely heavily on overdamped Langevin dynamics or Markovian assumptions. The transition from theoretical lower bounds to measurable dissipation in experimental setups with finite-lived memory states remains under-constrained.
detail.next_questions: What specific noise profiles in information-bearing channels most significantly contribute to the deviation from the theoretical Landauer limit in real-world electronic devices?
